race.description: Sun Centre Curtains And Blinds Hcp (56)
race.comment: PONTE ARCOBALENO (5) produced a reasonable effort when second last start over 1209m at Yarra Valley, beaten 2.75 lengths. That followed a win at Manangatang the start prior. Well placed and there is no reason he cannot keep the good recent run going. ARTPARK (14) has been disappointing at his past couple of starts in SA, but was racing well closer to home earlier in the season and might go better this side of the border. VILLE DE LUMIERE (8) resumed for a new stable at Ballarat on Nov 11 and although a big price ($41), did a good job to get within 1.5 lengths of the winner. Goes close here with further improvement. AMBELLO (9) was terrible last start but found only one better the previous two, beaten less than a length in each. Repeat of those performances has him in the mix here.
